methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: propose a practical framework that integrates energy and environmental management systems

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Proposes an integrated management-system framework (ISO 50001/14001/14064) to help facilities qualify for carbon funds. Energy baseline and energy performance indicators appear only as generic ISO 50001 process steps (reference-year baseline; monthly indicators compared with the baseline), with no specific EnPI/EnB measurement model identified or characterised (no functional form, defined variable set, or estimation approach).

paper_type.evidence_quote: This section makes an attempt to formulate a framework that integrates energy and environmental management systems, as applied to the facilities sector.

stage1.notes: Framework/management-systems paper; baseline and EnPIs mentioned only as generic ISO 50001 steps, not a characterised model. Application context is facilities in general, not a continuous-process sector.
